assessment: This is an important paper reporting that an adenosine methyltransferase in the model plant Arabidopsis functions to target a key RNA component of the spliceosome, as in fission yeast, and thereby contributes to intron recognition as well as flowering timing. By contrast, the authors report no major role for the methyltransferase in targeting mRNAs, as reported in several previous studies in Arabidopsis. Overall, the approaches are convincing, although a correlative analysis identifying an intronic sequence feature characteristic of methyltransferase-sensitive introns is not followed up with tests to establish causality of this feature.
